title: Who Killed the Guest?
victim.name: The Guest
story.arrival.1: On the first night of Chinese New Year, the whole family gathers at the old house.
story.arrival.2: The doorbell rings. A guest nobody recognises drops by, calling himself an “old friend”.
story.arrival.3: At dinner, the guest smiles: “I know every one of your secrets.” Nobody is smiling now.
story.murder.1: Midnight fireworks. Everyone is scattered around the house.
story.murder.2: Suddenly, the whole house loses power.
story.murder.3: In the dark, someone is moving…
story.murder.6: The lights come back on. The guest is gone!
story.briefing.1: After searching the house, everyone finds the guest on the front steps. He isn’t breathing.
story.briefing.2: Drag marks on the floor: the body was moved. He was killed in one of the eight rooms inside.
story.briefing.3: The doors were locked all night. The killer is one of the six of you.
story.briefing.4: Find out three things: Who? Where? With what?
tut.board: This is the board. The red square in the middle is the case envelope; the 8 rooms surround it.
tut.players: All players are up here. The big avatar with the timer ring is whoever is playing. Each turn has 60 seconds.
tut.roll: On your turn, tap here to roll the die.
tut.move: Move up to the number you roll. Glowing squares and rooms are reachable. You can only suggest inside a room.
tut.notes: Notes track clues: ✕ no, ✓ has it, ? maybe. Your own cards are already ticked.
tut.accuse: When you’re sure, tap Accuse. One chance only: a wrong guess turns you into a ghost.
tut.reactions: Tap here to send a reaction. Everyone sees it on their phone and on the TV.
